people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: Joab sent messengers to David, and said, “I have fought against Rabbah. Yes, I have taken the city of waters.
translations.bsb: Then Joab sent messengers to David to say, “I have fought against Rabbah and have captured the water supply of the city.
translations.kjv: And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, I have fought against Rabbah, and have taken the city of waters.
translations.asv: And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, I have fought against Rabbah; yea, I have taken the city of waters.
